senses: to pass on or away, pass through, pass by, go through, grow up, change, to go on from
to come on anew, sprout again (of grass)
to change, substitute, alter, change for better, renew

strongs.def: properly, to slide by, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, pass on, spring up, pierce or change
strongs.kjv: abolish, alter, change, cut off, go on forward, grow up, be over, pass (away, on, through), renew, sprout, strike through
